about.name: Mansur Ali Khan
about.bio: AI Policy Researcher and student of Law, Economics, & Public Policy at the University of Washington-Bothell. His research focuses on AI legislation topical and structural trends. He has worked with Washington state legislators on local AI legislation to bridge research with legislation. And is interested in studying coordination frameworks of AI governance to help make effective, implementable AI policies.
